title: Spiral out
instructions: A for loop repeats its { } a set number of times, and its counter i can be used like any variable. Visit the circles in order and stop on the X using only 2 commands.
hint: The sides are 2, 4, 6, and 8 cells long. You can do math inside the ( ): + - * / work like in math class (* means times), and a - in front flips the sign, like -x. So i * 2 is 2, 4, 6, 8 as i goes 1, 2, 3, 4.
